t: A fast 32-bit chip with built-in USB for CircuitPython, sound and lights.
steps: Buy an Adafruit Feather M4 Express or ItsyBitsy M4 Express from Adafruit or a maker shop.
Get a micro USB cable that carries data.
Plug in the board and double-tap the reset button. A USB drive appears.
Drag the CircuitPython file for your board onto that drive.
Install the free Mu editor on your computer.
Open code.py in Mu and paste the Blink example from the Adafruit guide.
Save the file. The light on the board starts to blink at once.
meta: Wild Open. From $14.95. A few stores.
